headline: Callahan's Passage Trading Hands as Weathered Expanse Bleeds On
war_summary: Since our last edition, the line of posts on Callahan's Passage has shifted from nine Warden holds to eight against two Colonial, twenty-two actions marking its day's ledger, Crumbling Post, The Crumbling Passage and The Latch the busiest grounds, with fresh work logged at 11:20. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's bloodiest field: thirty-seven base actions in the past day, eight posts reduced to no-man's-land, and Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Huntsfort hardest fought; its cumulative toll now stands near 220,000 against 254,000, the last report filed minutes before this edition closes. The Nevish Line stays alight as well, Blackcoat Way and Princefal again the most contested, fourteen actions recorded. Stlican Shelf now counts one demolished work among its nine posts, Fort Hoarfrost taken ten times over; Stonecradle rests at two Warden bases to seven Colonial; and Linn Mercy's hourly losses about Lathair are climbing sharply once more. Most other fronts lie quiet, their ledgers gathering dust. It is day 451 of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
